metadata.case_name: WONG KWUN SANG v. YIU WOON MING AND OTHERS

injuries.icd_description: Fracture of skull or facial bones, part unspecified

injuries.description: thick left epidural haematoma in the vicinity of the skull fracture
source: (b) thick left epidural haematoma in the vicinity of the skull fracture;
CT performed at around 20:00 h on 12.1.2002 showed ... (c) left epidural haematoma, elliptical in shape (2.5 x 4 x 5.5 cm) and exerting prominent mass effect.

injuries.description: intracerebral haematoma to the right side of the right ventricle with intraventricular extension
injuries.body_part: right basal ganglia / caudate nucleus and right lateral ventricle
source: (c) intracerebral haematoma to the right side of the right ventricle with intraventricular extension, i.e. blood flowing into the ventricle.

CT performed at around 20:00 h on 12.1.2002 showed three sites of intracranial haemorrhage: (a) a large right basal ganglia haemorrhage especially at the caudate neucleus ...; (b) intraventricular haemorrhage with blood in the right lateral ventricle;

injuries.description: left frontal tract haematoma / small haemorrhagic contusion at the left frontal lobe
source: two emergency neurosurgical operations were carried out. The first one for the evacuation of the epidural haematoma, followed by another surgical evacuation of left frontal tract haematoma the next day.
CT ... There was also a small haemorrhagic contusion at the left frontal lobe.
he was found to be deeply comatose having sustained a fracture of the skull with epidural haematoma, intracerebral bleeding and diffuse brain damage.
The brain damage has also resulted in loss of urinary and bowel functions.
injuries.icd_description: Diffuse injury of multiple parts of brain

source: There was some slow but positive progress up to December 2003 when his condition deteriorated due to development of hydrocephalus which was managed conservatively.

injuries.description: spastic tetraplegia from the brain damage
source: remained severely demented, aphasic, devoid of cognitive power and weakened by spastic tetraplegia from the brain damage.
weakened by spastic tetraplegia from the brain damage.

manifestations.description: vegetative state / almost total vegetative state with slight awareness
bed and wheelchair bound for life and wholly dependent on others for all activities of daily living
loss of urinary and bowel functions

treatments_received: evacuation of the epidural haematoma (emergency neurosurgical operation)
surgical evacuation of left frontal tract haematoma (emergency neurosurgical operation)
long term care at the infirmary unit of Princess Margaret Hospital (Lai King)
suppository insertion every two to three days for bowel opening
daily bodily cleaning and twice-weekly showering

losses.description: The brain damage has also resulted in loss of urinary and bowel functions.
bed and wheelchair bound for life and wholly dependent on others for all activities of daily living.
bed and wheelchair bound for life
remained severely demented and devoid of cognitive power
